meta_description: Eden Garden Services Southampton. Professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Local family business. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Local Southampton Gardener — Full Garden Care & Design
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformation—we'll get your outdoor space looking brilliant again.
services_subhead: From routine maintenance and seasonal pruning to full garden design and landscaping, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, edging, and lawn treatment to keep your garden looking pristine. We tailor visit frequency to suit your needs and season.

services.title: Hedging & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning and shaping of hedges and shrubs to promote healthy growth and maintain neat, attractive borders year-round.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Spring clearance, autumn leaf collection, and winter preparation. We clear debris, prune back dead growth, and ready your garden for the months ahead.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Full garden transformation from concept to completion. We design layouts that work for your lifestyle and budget, handling all planting and hard landscaping.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: New patios, decking, and garden structures built to last. We manage the whole project, from groundwork through to finishing touches.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Removal
services.desc: Safe felling, crown reduction, and stump removal for large trees. All work follows British standards and includes proper disposal and site clearance.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like our own, and customers notice the difference.
about_para_1: Eden Garden Services was founded on the principle that a well-maintained garden transforms how you enjoy your home. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation across Southampton for reliable, thorough work—whether it's a fortnightly lawn cut or a complete garden redesign. We're a small, tight-knit team who know the local climate, soil, and growing conditions inside out.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we're punctual, and we take pride in the detail. We're not here to oversell you services you don't need—we'll give you honest advice about what your garden needs and when. Many of our clients have been with us for years, and their gardens show it.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolute lifesaver. Garden was completely overgrown after the winter and I had no idea where to start. Dave and the team came in, sorted it all out in a day, and now it's my favourite space again. Fair pricing too.
reviews.author: Rebecca T.

reviews.text: Been using Eden for the lawn cuts for about three years now. Never let us down, always professional, and the lads actually care about what they're doing. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Michael H.

reviews.text: Had them in to design and build a new patio with raised beds. They listened to what we wanted, stuck to the budget, and the finished garden is stunning. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Linda S.
